title: refX
tagline: Unlock Trust: where employment reference checks meet blockchain. Your Ultimate Solution for Reference Checks!
description:
Are you tired of the hassle and uncertainty surrounding traditional reference checks? Say goodbye to outdated methods and welcome RefX into your hiring toolkit! Leveraging Zero-Knowledge technology, With RefX, each verification is immutable and trusted, providing you with peace of mind throughout the hiring process. Plus, our platform is incredibly efficient, allowing you to access reference information anywhere, anytime, with just a few clicks.

But that's not all – by adopting RefX, employers can save significant time and resources previously spent on cumbersome reference checks. Boost your hiring process with a solution that is not only efficient but also highly trusted.
how_its_made:
As a web3 company, our industry is inherently aligned with remote work and operates 24/7. Conducting reference checks poses a significant challenge when we lack connections in a candidate's region or country.

Currently, the process of performing reference checks consumes considerable time and resources, and even then, the results may not be entirely reliable. To address this issue, we are considering developing a solution built on chain. This approach would ensure that all published information is verified, while also protecting individuals' personal data through the use of zero-knowledge (ZK) technologies.

Additionally, we have integrated with Worldcoin to guarantee that each identity is unique. This integration enhances the security and reliability of our verification process, making it more streamlined and trustworthy.
